description: This file contains template specializations for serializing and deserializing various data types used in the Google Breakpad project, including basic types, source line info, symbols, and frame info, with support for linked pointers.

classes.name: SimpleSerializer<bool>
classes.description: Template specialization for serializing boolean values.

classes.name: SimpleSerializer<string>
classes.description: Template specialization for serializing std::string values.

classes.name: SimpleSerializer<const char*>
classes.description: Template specialization for serializing C-string values.

classes.name: SimpleSerializer<BasicSourceLineResolver::Line>
classes.description: Template specialization for serializing source line information.

classes.name: SimpleSerializer<BasicSourceLineResolver::PublicSymbol>
classes.description: Template specialization for serializing public symbol information.

classes.name: SimpleSerializer<WindowsFrameInfo>
classes.description: Template specialization for serializing Windows frame info.

classes.name: SimpleSerializer< linked_ptr<BasicSourceLineResolver::Line> >
classes.description: Template specialization for serializing linked pointer to source line.

classes.name: SimpleSerializer<BasicSourceLineResolver::Function>
classes.description: Template specialization for serializing function info.

classes.name: SimpleSerializer< linked_ptr<BasicSourceLineResolver::Function> >
classes.description: Template specialization for serializing linked pointer to function.

classes.name: SimpleSerializer< linked_ptr<BasicSourceLineResolver::PublicSymbol> >
classes.description: Template specialization for serializing linked pointer to public symbol.

classes.name: SimpleSerializer< linked_ptr<WindowsFrameInfo> >
classes.description: Template specialization for serializing linked pointer to Windows frame info.

methods.name: SizeOf
methods.description: Calculates the size needed to serialize the object.

methods.name: Write
methods.description: Serializes the object into a buffer.

methods.name: Read
methods.description: Deserializes the object from a buffer.
